rootCause: The candidate ledger lacked a structured current-cost projection for the verified get_recipe_detail envelope. A legacy/redacted lookup transport could preserve canonical recipe ID while omitting its display name, so the current amount was not reliably claimable with an owner-visible entity name.

repair.binding: The ledger hydrates a display name only when the same verified detail record has exactly the bound recipe ID and provides its own recipe name. No cross-record lookup or numeric-ID exposure is added to the model-facing catalog.
